dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: No victory is eternal, but even a temporary triumph tastes sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Thanks to Kion{RUBY#[D]Leader}gozi, and to you, Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini, the deeds of our heroes stand strong as the mountains and vibrant stone.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: As we warriors always say, unity will allow us to persevere until victory is won.
